title: BattINFO publisher prefix register
description: The shape of prefixes.json. That numbers are unique and given out in sequence from 1000 is checked by battinfo.namespace when it loads the file.

prefix.description: The publisher's number: four digits, written as a string.

holder.description: The minting authority the number was given to.

records.description: Whether records are minted under id/{prefix}/. False for a prefix that holds definitions only.

resolver.description: The https URL the publisher's addresses are served from, or null when it has no resolver of its own.

allocated.description: The date the number was given out (YYYY-MM-DD).
